description:
Health insurance is one aspect which should not be ignored at any stage and the first step you should take is to go in for a health insurance because if things don't go as per your plan than these white coat guys are going to make you bankrupt.

Medical Insurance or so called care health insurance is a must and you should not ignore it. Have a look at all health insurance plans and undertake due diligence on its plusses and minuses and then choose the plan as per your need. HDFC and ICICI plans are reasonable in health sector and one can consider going with them as these companies are going to stay put in India. We want you to have a mediclaim policy to take care of the unseen event.

The video talks about the importance of health insurance as the first investment and its benefits, inclusions, and exclusions. Health insurance provides financial protection during medical emergencies and also covers lifestyle diseases. It is important to check the coverage, pre and post-hospitalization expenses, day care facilities, ambulance charges, and restoration and top-up benefits available in the policy. The waiting period for pre-existing diseases is generally 2-4 years. The amount of health insurance cover depends on factors like age, medical history, income level, and lifestyle, and one should take a minimum cover of Rs. 3 lakhs for an individual and Rs. 5-10 lakhs for a family of four. It is also advisable to check for no claim bonus and preventive health check-up benefits in the policy.

The video talks about the ideal health insurance ratio between premiums and claims to assess a company's profitability. The healthy ratio is between 70-90, but 55-60 is also acceptable. The flexibility of these ratios depends on the company's brand value.
